Hi Matt — thanks for the clear summary and the load profile. Short answers up front and a proposed next step below.

Measurement rules (short):
- p50/p95 are computed per "request" latency at the API gateway ingress — includes time spent in our queueing layer and model runtime, measured from request HEADERS received to final byte of response sent.
- We do not break down by token for SLA; token-level costs are separate telemetry.
- Multi-turn chat: each API call is measured separately (so individual turn latencies are what count).

Temporary carveout options:
A) Time-bounded exception: carve out a defined clock window (e.g., 2028-03-10T18:00 to 2028-03-11T06:00 PST) where p95 for that window is excluded from rolling SLA calculations.
B) Adjusted target: during migration window, we temporarily relax p95 from Xms to Yms for affected routes and formalize the change in an addendum.

Evidence we require for A/B:
- Timestamped access logs (ingress IDs) showing start/end of elevated latency.
- Correlated infra metrics (instance CPU/GPU utilization, queue depth) for the window.
- Short post-mortem within 48 hours documenting mitigation steps and a rollback plan if issues persist.

Proposal (next step):
- If you agree, we will draft a short addendum that: (1) defines the window, (2) lists required artifacts (we can accept logging via the Drive link you shared), and (3) specifies an on-call escalation contact.

I'm looping in Lauren (customer success) and Karthik (SRE/measurements) so we can scope the evidence checklist and timeline.

—Mina

Hi Matt — following internal alignment, here's the concrete path forward so you can add it to the mutual action plan: 

1) Please confirm the exact UTC window you want carved out. From our end we can support up to a 72-hour time-bounded carveout; typical practice is a single continuous window.

2) Evidence checklist (we only need samples, not full logs):
   - Ingress request IDs (10 random IDs across the window) + one complete trace per ID.
   - Server-side latency histogram for the window (we can accept Prometheus CSV or our CSV template).
   - Queue depth and node utilization summary (1-min granularity) for the window and the 24h prior.

3) Audit & SLA impact:
   - If you provide the artifacts within 72 hours of the window close and the post-mortem within 48 hours thereafter, we will exclude the defined clock window from rolling p95 SLA calculations and not count it towards penalty triggers.
   - We will persist an audit entry in the contract portal and attach the evidence bundle to the deal record (HubSpot link: https://hubspot.com/deal/6789123).

4) On-call & follow-up:
   - Our SRE on-call for your window will be: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com (cc'd). Please include an escalation phone number when you send the artifacts.

I'll attach a short addendum and the minimal evidence template (proposed-carveout-mrp.docx) for signature. If that sounds good, confirm the start/end timestamps and we will generate the addendum today.
